import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    st=np.sqrt(t); sA=np.sqrt(A)
    return (params[0]*A + params[1]*st + params[2]*t/A + params[3]*t**2
            + params[4]*st*A + params[5]*A**2 + params[6]*st*A**2
            + params[7]*A*np.log(A) + params[8]*t*sA + params[9]*st*sA)
